import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.PositiveFiberClosedGeometry

/-!
# Actual whole-component transport geometry

The two scalar interpolations have positive true derivatives. Their
displayed triangular chart and its displayed inverse therefore supply
all open and closed geometry, symmetries, and genuine middle germs.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

structure WholeComponentTransportGeometry
    (τ σ : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) (l r c d J : ℝ) : Prop where
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ
  inverse_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ σ
  left_inverse : Function.LeftInverse σ τ
  right_inverse : Function.RightInverse σ τ
  jacobian_lower : ∀ p, J ≤ planeJacobian τ p
  jacobian_positive : ∀ p, 0 < planeJacobian τ p
  bijOn : BijOn τ (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_open : MapsTo τ (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_open : MapsTo σ
    (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Ioo l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  maps_closed : MapsTo τ (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  inverse_maps_closed : MapsTo σ
    (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)) (Icc l r ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ))
  period_add : ∀ p, τ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = τ p + (0, Real.pi)
  inverse_period_add : ∀ p, σ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = σ p + (0, Real.pi)
  reflect : ∀ p, τ (p.1, -p.2) = ((τ p).1, -(τ p).2)
  inverse_reflect : ∀ p, σ (p.1, -p.2) = ((σ p).1, -(σ p).2)
  middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, τ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  inverse_middle_germ : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
    σ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint)
  boundary_inverse : ∀ p, CanonicalBoundaryInverseGerm τ σ p

theorem wholeComponentTransportGeometry_of_scalars
    {φ Y : PolarPoint → ℝ} {κ B l r c d : ℝ}
    (hφ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y) (hκ : 0 < κ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hφLower : ∀ x θ, κ ≤ deriv (fun η => φ (x, η)) θ)
    (hYLower : ∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x)
    (hφPeriod : ∀ x θ, φ (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφOdd : ∀ x θ, φ (x, -θ) = -φ (x, θ))
    (hYPeriod : ∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ))
    (hYEven : ∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ))
    (hleft : ∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) (hright : ∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r)
    (hφMiddle : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
      φ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.snd : PolarPoint → ℝ))
    (hYMiddle : ∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ,
      Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) :
    WholeComponentTransportGeometry
      (positiveFiberChart φ Y) (positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y) l r c d (B * κ) := by
  let τ := positiveFiberChart φ Y
  let σ := positiveFiberChartInverse φ Y
  obtain ⟨hτ, hσ, hστ, hτσ, hJ⟩ :=
    positiveFiberChart_geometry hφ hY hκ hB Real.pi_ne_zero hφLower hYLower hφPeriod
  have hJpos (p : PolarPoint) : 0 < planeJacobian τ p :=
    (mul_pos hB hκ).trans_le (hJ p)
  have hbij := positiveFiberChart_bijOn_openStrip
    hφ hY hκ hB Real.pi_ne_zero hφLower hYLower hφPeriod hleft hright
  have hclosed := positiveFiberChart_maps_closedStrip (φ := φ) hY hB hYLower hleft hright
  have hperiod (p : PolarPoint) : τ (p + (0, Real.pi)) = τ p + (0, Real.pi) :=
    positiveFiberChart_period_add hφPeriod hYPeriod p
  have hreflect (p : PolarPoint) : τ (p.1, -p.2) = ((τ p).1, -(τ p).2) :=
    positiveFiberChart_reflect hφOdd hYEven p
  have hmiddle (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Icc c d) (θ : ℝ) :
      τ =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (id : PolarPoint → PolarPoint) := by
    filter_upwards [hφMiddle x hx θ, hYMiddle x hx θ] with p hpφ hpY
    change (Y (p.1, φ p), φ p) = p
    rw [hpφ]
    exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [Prod.eta] using hpY) rfl
  refine {
    smooth := hτ
    inverse_smooth := hσ
    left_inverse := hστ
    right_inverse := hτσ
    jacobian_lower := hJ
    jacobian_positive := hJpos
    bijOn := hbij
    maps_open := hbij.mapsTo
    inverse_maps_open := ?_
    maps_closed := hclosed.1
    inverse_maps_closed := hclosed.2
    period_add := hperiod
    inverse_period_add := ?_
    reflect := hreflect
    inverse_reflect := inverse_reflect_of_forward_reflect hστ hτσ hreflect
    middle_germ := hmiddle
    inverse_middle_germ := ?_
    boundary_inverse := fun p => canonicalBoundaryInverseGerm_of_global_leftInverse
      hτ.contDiffAt (hJpos p).ne' hστ }
  · intro p hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, heq⟩ := hbij.surjOn hp
    rw [← heq, hστ]
    exact hq
  · intro p
    apply hστ.injective
    dsimp only [τ] at hperiod
    rw [hτσ, hperiod, hτσ]
  · intro x hx θ
    filter_upwards [hmiddle x hx θ] with p hp
    exact (congrArg σ hp.symm).trans (hστ p)

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.EndpointFiberInterpolation
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.AngularFiberFiniteJetBounds

/-!
# Radial interpolation in the actual angular inverse coordinates

The displayed fiber coordinate uses the true inverse of the chosen
angular lift. A supplied bound on its finite boundary traces determines
the displayed widths. A second theorem obtains that bound from the
ordinary forward jets, uniformly before the family index.
This is a new reconstruction after the workspace reset.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate (n : ℕ) (φ : PolarPoint → ℝ)
    (X : Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ) (l r c d κ Mσ : ℝ) : PolarPoint → ℝ :=
  endpointFiberInterpolation n l r c d (endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κ Mσ)
    (fun side => radialBoundaryJet (angularFiberPullback φ (X side))
      (if side then r else l))

theorem endpointFiberPullback_family_of_bound
    {ι : Type*} {n : ℕ} {φ : ι → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d κX Mσ : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκX : 0 < κX) (hMσ : 0 ≤ Mσ)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (X i side))
    (hpositive : ∀ i (p : PolarPoint), 0 < deriv (fun θ => φ i (p.1, θ)) p.2)
    (hφperiod : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ i (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφodd : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, -θ) = -φ i (x, θ))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hbound : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      |radialBoundaryJet (angularFiberPullback (φ i) (X i side))
        (if side then r else l) k θ| ≤ Mσ) :
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n (φ i) (X i) l r c d κX Mσ
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Y (p.1, φ i p)) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (X i side) (if side then r else l) k θ := by
  let e : Bool → ℝ := fun side => if side then r else l
  let Z : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ := fun i side =>
    angularFiberPullback (φ i) (X i side)
  let A : ι → Bool → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i side => radialBoundaryJet (Z i side) (e side)
  have hZ (i : ι) (side : Bool) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Z i side) :=
    contDiff_angularFiberPullback Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
      (hpositive i) (hφperiod i)
  have hvalue (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : A i side 0 θ = e side := by
    change iteratedDeriv 0 (fun x => Z i side (x, θ)) (e side) = e side
    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero] using
      angularFiberPullback_boundary (φ := φ i) (hXvalue i side) θ
  have hlow (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) : κX ≤ A i side 1 θ := by
    change κX ≤ iteratedDeriv 1 (fun x => Z i side (x, θ)) (e side)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one,
      deriv_cylinder_radial_slice ((hZ i side).differentiable (by simp)) (e side) θ,
      radialPartial_angularFiberPullback_boundary Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
        (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (hXvalue i side)]
    exact hXlow i side _
  have hperiod (i : ι) (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) :
      Function.Periodic (A i side j) Real.pi := by
    intro θ
    exact radialBoundaryJet_angleInvariant (fun θ => θ + Real.pi)
      (angularFiberPullback_periodic Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hpositive i)
        (hφperiod i) (hXperiod i side)) (e side) j θ
  have heven (i : ι) (side : Bool) (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      A i side j (-θ) = A i side j θ :=
    radialBoundaryJet_angleInvariant (fun θ => -θ)
      (angularFiberPullback_reflect Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hpositive i)
        (hφperiod i) (hφodd i) (hXeven i side)) (e side) j θ
  have hout := endpointFiberInterpolation_family hlc hcd hdr hκX hMσ
    (fun i side j _ => contDiff_radialBoundaryJet (hZ i side) (e side) j)
    hvalue hlow hbound (fun i side j _ => hperiod i side j)
    (fun i side j _ => heven i side j)
  dsimp only at hout ⊢
  rcases hout with ⟨hη, hηgap, hB, hout⟩
  refine ⟨hη, hηgap, hB, ?_⟩
  intro i
  rcases hout i with ⟨hY, hYlow, hleft, hright, hYperiod, hYeven, hmiddle, hjet⟩
  refine ⟨hY, hYlow, hleft, hright, hYperiod, hYeven, hmiddle, ?_⟩
  intro side
  exact radialBoundaryJets_angularFiber_composition Real.pi_ne_zero
    (hφ i) (hX i side) hY (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (hjet side)

theorem exists_endpointFiberPullback_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {φ : ι → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {X : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ} {l r c d κφ κX M : ℝ}
    (hlc : l < c) (hcd : c < d) (hdr : d < r)
    (hκφ : 0 < κφ) (hκX : 0 < κX) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hφ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (φ i))
    (hX : ∀ i side, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (X i side))
    (hφLower : ∀ i x θ, κφ ≤ deriv (fun η => φ i (x, η)) θ)
    (hφperiod : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, θ + Real.pi) = φ i (x, θ) + Real.pi)
    (hφodd : ∀ i x θ, φ i (x, -θ) = -φ i (x, θ))
    (hXvalue : ∀ i side θ, X i side (if side then r else l, θ) = if side then r else l)
    (hXlow : ∀ i side θ, κX ≤ radialPartial (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hφraw : ∀ i (side : Bool) k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXraw : ∀ i side k, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (X i side) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M)
    (hXperiod : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = X i side (x, θ))
    (hXeven : ∀ i side x θ, X i side (x, -θ) = X i side (x, θ)) :
    ∃ Mσ : ℝ, 1 ≤ Mσ ∧
    let η := endpointFiberWidths n l r c d κX Mσ
    let B := endpointFiberLower n l r c d κX Mσ
    (∀ side, 0 < η side) ∧
      (∀ side, 2 * η side < (if side then r else c) - (if side then d else l)) ∧
      0 < B ∧ ∀ i,
      let Y := endpointFiberPullbackCoordinate n (φ i) (X i) l r c d κX Mσ
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y ∧
      (∀ x θ, B ≤ deriv (fun t => Y (t, θ)) x) ∧
      (∀ θ, Y (l, θ) = l) ∧ (∀ θ, Y (r, θ) = r) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, θ + Real.pi) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Y (x, -θ) = Y (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ Icc c d, ∀ θ, Y =ᶠ[𝓝 (x, θ)] (Prod.fst : PolarPoint → ℝ)) ∧
      ∀ side k, k ≤ n + 1 → ∀ θ,
        radialBoundaryJet (fun p => Y (p.1, φ i p)) (if side then r else l) k θ =
          radialBoundaryJet (X i side) (if side then r else l) k θ := by
  have hpositive (i : ι) (p : PolarPoint) :
      0 < deriv (fun θ => φ i (p.1, θ)) p.2 :=
    hκφ.trans_le (hφLower i p.1 p.2)
  have hangle (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      κφ ≤ angularPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ) := by
    rw [← deriv_cylinder_angular_slice ((hφ i).differentiable (by simp))]
    exact hφLower i _ θ
  have hradial (i : ι) (side : Bool) (θ : ℝ) :
      |radialPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)| ≤ M := by
    have hfirst : ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ ≤ M := by
      simpa only [norm_iteratedFDeriv_one] using
        hφraw i side 1 le_rfl (by omega) θ
    have hunit :
        |radialPartial (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)| ≤
          ‖fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)‖ := by
      simpa [radialPartial, Prod.norm_def] using
        (fderiv ℝ (φ i) (if side then r else l, θ)).le_opNorm (1, 0)
    exact hunit.trans hfirst
  obtain ⟨Mσ, hMσ, hbound⟩ := exists_angularFiberBoundaryJets_bound (n + 1) hκφ hM
  refine ⟨Mσ, hMσ, endpointFiberPullback_family_of_bound hlc hcd hdr
    hκX (zero_le_one.trans hMσ) hφ hX hpositive hφperiod hφodd
    hXvalue hXlow hXperiod hXeven ?_⟩
  intro i side k hk hkn θ
  exact hbound (φ i) (X i side) Real.pi Real.pi_ne_zero (hφ i) (hX i side)
    (hpositive i) (hφperiod i) (if side then r else l)
    (hangle i side) (hradial i side) (hφraw i side) (hXraw i side) k hk hkn θ

end ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.OneSidedBoundaryTaylorRepresentative
import ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis.EndpointHeightValueBounds

/-!
# One common explicit collar for genuine one-sided height fields

The radius is the reciprocal of a displayed sum. Its inverse cost is
therefore exact, and its choice precedes the family index. Finite
ordinary jets match the actual one-sided field at both root circles.
-/

noncomputable section

namespace ContinuousFlexibility.Analysis

open Set Filter
open ContinuousFlexibility.Statements
open scoped Topology ContDiff

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

def oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth (n : ℕ) (ρ M : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1))⁻¹

theorem oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth_margins (n : ℕ) {ρ M : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hM : 0 ≤ M) :
    let δ := oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth n ρ M
    0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1) ∧
      ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * M * δ ≤ 1 := by
  let N : ℝ := ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let D : ℝ := ρ⁻¹ + 1 + N * (M + 1)
  have hN : 0 < N := by
    change (0 : ℝ) < ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
    exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_pos n
  have hρinv : 0 < ρ⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr hρ
  have hprod : 0 ≤ N * (M + 1) := mul_nonneg hN.le (by linarith)
  have hD : 0 < D := by dsimp only [D]; positivity
  have hDρ : ρ⁻¹ ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; linarith only [hprod]
  have hDone : 1 ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; linarith only [hρinv, hprod]
  have hδρ : D⁻¹ ≤ ρ := by
    simpa only [inv_inv] using (inv_le_inv₀ hD hρinv).mpr hDρ
  have hδone : D⁻¹ ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [inv_one] using (inv_le_inv₀ hD zero_lt_one).mpr hDone
  have hNM : N * M ≤ D := by dsimp only [D]; nlinarith only [hN, hρinv]
  have hsmall := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hNM (inv_nonneg.mpr hD.le)
  rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hD.ne'] at hsmall
  exact ⟨inv_pos.mpr hD, hδρ, hδone, inv_inv D, hsmall⟩

theorem exists_oneSidedEndpointHeight_family
    {ι : Type*} (n : ℕ) {h : ι → Bool → PolarPoint → ℝ}
    {a b : Bool → ℝ} {l r ρ M H : ℝ}
    (hab : ∀ side, a side < b side)
    (hend : ∀ side, (if side then r else l) ∈ Icc (a side) (b side))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρwidth : 2 * ρ ≤ r - l) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hH : 1 ≤ H)
    (hregular : ∀ i side, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (h i side)
      (Ioo (a side) (b side) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ)))
    (hroot : ∀ i side θ, ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (h i side) (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hpositive : ∀ i side θ, 0 < h i side (if side then r else l, θ))
    (hupper : ∀ i side θ, h i side (if side then r else l, θ) ≤ H)
    (hinverse : ∀ i side θ, (h i side (if side then r else l, θ))⁻¹ ≤ H)
    (hlog : ∀ i side j, 0 < j → j ≤ n → ∀ θ,
      |positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j θ| ≤ M)
    (hperiod : ∀ i side, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      h i side (x, θ + Real.pi) = h i side (x, θ))
    (heven : ∀ i side, ∀ x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ,
      h i side (x, -θ) = h i side (x, θ)) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ ρ ∧ δ ≤ 1 ∧
      δ⁻¹ = ρ⁻¹ + 1 + ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M + 1) ∧
      ∀ i,
      let Q := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation n l r δ (fun _ => 1) (h i)
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q ∧
      (∀ p, 0 < Q p) ∧
      (∀ side k, k ≤ n → ∀ θ,
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ k Q (if side then r else l, θ) =
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ k (h i side) (if side then r else l, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Q (x, θ + Real.pi) = Q (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ x θ, Q (x, -θ) = Q (x, θ)) ∧
      (∀ p, p.1 ∉ Metric.ball l δ → p.1 ∉ Metric.ball r δ →
        Q =ᶠ[𝓝 p] (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) ∧
      ∀ p, Q p ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 ∧ (Q p)⁻¹ ≤ Real.exp 2 * H ^ 2 := by
  let δ := oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth n ρ M
  obtain ⟨hδ, hδρ, hδone, hinv, hsmall⟩ :=
    oneSidedEndpointHeightWidth_margins n hρ hM
  have hgap : 2 * δ ≤ r - l := (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδρ (by norm_num)).trans hρwidth
  have hRef : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : PolarPoint => (1 : ℝ)) := contDiff_const
  have hRefPos : ∀ _ : PolarPoint, (0 : ℝ) < 1 := fun _ => zero_lt_one
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, hδρ, hδone, hinv, ?_⟩
  intro i
  obtain ⟨hQ, hQpos⟩ := positiveHeightTaylorInterpolation_smooth_positive
    hRef hRefPos (hroot i) (hpositive i) n δ
  have hData (side : Bool) (τ : ℝ → ℝ) (hτ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ τ)
      (he : ∀ x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side), ∀ θ, h i side (x, τ θ) = h i side (x, θ))
      (j : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
      positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j (τ θ) =
        positiveHeightTaylorData l r (fun _ => 1) (h i) side j θ := by
    have hlogroot (η : ℝ) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side))
        (if side then r else l, η) := by
      change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun p : PolarPoint => Real.log (h i side p / 1)) _
      simpa only [div_one] using
        (hroot i side η).log (hpositive i side η).ne'
    have heLog (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioo (a side) (b side)) (η : ℝ) :
        boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side) (x, τ η) =
          0 + 1 * boundaryHeightLogRatio (fun _ => 1) (h i side) (x, η) := by
      simpa only [boundaryHeightLogRatio, div_one, zero_add, one_mul] using
        congrArg Real.log (he x hx η)
    simpa only [positiveHeightTaylorData, ite_self, zero_add, one_mul] using
      radialBoundaryJet_angleAffine_on_closedStrip
        (hab side) (hend side) hlogroot hτ heLog j θ
  refine ⟨hQ, hQpos, ?_, ?_, ?_,
